execution_rules: Main line: whole algorithm unification in patch_list order. Side work only overlaps build/run/scoring waits; never blocks the main line.
Continue accepted first step and completed README/patch plan; do not restart.
Reuse accepted A states; final same-version real A->B->C and synthetic A->B still required.
Locate existing offline fast tests and synthetic data/protocol before running; reuse existing results and no scorer/input changes.
Run short relevant failure screens before expensive online B; independent diagnostics may overlap with tests, no subagents.
Investigate observed Bonn/TUM stalls using owned logs and read-only existing tools; do not treat a retry as a fix.
Check memory/disk before additional heavy jobs; keep compressed maps and remove only explicitly owned temporary raw copies after scoring.
